question: Kathak dancer, Sitara Devi was awarded which of the following awards in 1973?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Padma Shri**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sitara Devi**

 
 
• ​**Sitara Devi**, also known as **Dhanlakshmi**, was an** Indian actress**, **singer**, and traditional **Kathak **dancer.
 
• She performed at a number of prestigious venues in India and overseas, including the **Carnegie **Hall in **New York (1967) **and the Royal Albert Hall in **London**.
 
• She was the recipient of numerous honours and prizes** (1976)**. Devi first met **Rabindranath Tagore **when she was a young girl, and he inspired her to bring back **Indian performing** arts like **Kathak**.
 
• After witnessing her performance when she was only sixteen years old, **Rabindranath Tagore** referred to her as Nritya Samragni, which translates to** "the empress of dance." **She is regarded by some as the **Kathak **queen.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://images.indianexpress.com/2017/11/who-is-sitara-devi_file_759.jpg] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Padma Shri**

 
 
• **​**The **Padma Shri**, which is often spelled **Padma Shree**, is India's fourth-highest civilian honour, behind the **Bharat Ratn**a,** Padma Vibhushan**, and** Padma Bhushan**.
 
• Awarded for "distinguished achievement in different realms of life, including the **arts**, **education**, **industry**, **literature**, **research**, **acting**, **medicine**, **social service**, and public affairs," the award was established on **January 2, 1954**.
 
• Every year on** India's Republic Day**, the Indian **government **presents it to the recipient.
